Measure it yourself

Free quote · extra discount

Self-measure discount−10%

Take your own measurements, send them to us, and get an extra 10% off. Once we receive your deposit, a representative visits to verify them.

Follow “How to measure”

  1. Inside mount needs at least 60mm depth in the sill (vertical blinds: 90mm).
  2. Inside mount: measure width and height three times, record the smallest. We subtract 10mm for clearance.
  3. Outside mount: add at least 50mm to each side, top and bottom (vertical blinds: 100mm).

Measurements in mm. Tile or granite cut-outs cost extra: amount not published

Carry-in guarantee on your blinds.

Factory fault? Send us a photo. We tell you if it goes to the factory or a technician can fix it on site (within 50km of our offices). If it goes to the factory, you carry it in to our offices.

All blinds get a double quality check.

Savings explained

Why we’re cheaper

Four reasons, in our own words from the About page.

  1. 1

    You measure, you save

    By self-measuring, you can avail an additional 10% discount and enjoy better prices as a reward for your effort to save.

    Saved: extra 10%
  2. 2

    No showroom rent

    Our showroom is exclusively online, which helps us avoid paying high rent for a physical showroom.

    Saved: rent
  3. 3

    Call-out fees up front

    To minimise our expenses, we charge call-out fees for measuring services. For measuring, it’s refunded upon ordering.

    Saved: costs
  4. 4

    One chat, one deal

    You can complete your entire transaction via email or WhatsApp, saving you money and the convenience of doing it from your home or office.

    Saved: running around

Direct from the factory. As authorised agents for multiple manufacturers in South Africa, we deliver the blinds directly from the factory to any location in the country. We can send you samples on request.

All blinds sold fall under the manufacturers’ full guarantees, administered by Blind Specialist. Our guarantee terms are on slip 7.

Family-run since 1995. It started with cleaning and repairing blinds, then became an agent for top manufacturers selling custom-made new blinds. Built on honesty, exceptional service and unbeatable prices.

Customers shown on our Happy Customers page include University of Zululand and Air Products Pinetown.
